home.tagline: Alchemists of the Great Year — rules wiki for players at the table.
home.intro.summary: Kismeta: Alchemists of the Great Year is a strategic card-and-dice game in which you and up to three friends take on the roles of rival Alchemists. Your goal is to complete the Alchemists' Great Work, transforming your Philosopher's Stone from Lead into Gold. Journey through the Cosmic Ages of the Great Year as you pursue this transformation, all the while under the watchful gaze of the Fates, the eternal keepers of the Crucible of Kismeta.
home.intro.playTimeValue: 1st Play/Quickplay ~ 1–2 hrs. | Standard ~ 2–3 hrs. | Magnus Alchemist ~ 3+ hrs.
